## Checklist

- [ ] `make test`, `make lint` and `cargo fmt --all --check` pass.
- [ ] Tests cover the new or changed behaviour.
- [ ] CONTRACT.md is updated if the wire protocol, the charter or the audit record changed.
- [ ] The docs in `docs/` are updated if users can see the change.
- [ ] `make schema` and `make proto` were run if the charter types or proto files changed.
